about.title: Dentistry that puts your smile first
body: Shine Dental Clinic sits on Sixth Avenue in Ramakrishna Nagar, Porur — a neighbourhood clinic built for families who want dependable dental care without traveling across the city for it. From routine check-ups to full smile makeovers, every treatment plan here is built around what actually gets your smile — and your comfort — where you want it.

The name isn't an accident. We lean into cosmetic dentistry — teeth whitening, veneers, and smile design — as much as we handle root canals, fillings, and implants, because we think a healthy mouth and a confident smile should come from the same visit, not two different clinics.
Our team keeps the clinic modern and unhurried: digital X-rays, single-use sterilized instruments, and appointment slots that don't leave you waiting past your booked time.
highlights: Cosmetic dentistry and smile makeovers as a genuine focus, not an afterthought
General, restorative, and cosmetic care under one roof
Digital imaging and fully sterilized instrumentation
Evening slots for working professionals in Porur

services.name: Smile Makeover
services.tagline: A custom plan to redesign your smile
services.overview: A combination of whitening, veneers, and minor alignment correction, planned around your facial features to give you a natural, brighter smile — Shine Dental Clinic's signature service.
symptoms: Gaps or minor misalignment affecting confidence
Wanting a refreshed look for an event or milestone
procedure: Smile design consultation and digital mock-up
Veneer fabrication and fitting where needed
benefits: Combines whitening, veneers, and minor correction in one plan
Boosts confidence without a full orthodontic commitment

faqs.question: How long does a full smile makeover take?
faqs.answer: Depending on scope, most plans run from a single extended visit for whitening-only cases to 2–3 weeks for veneer work requiring lab fabrication.

services.name: Teeth Whitening
services.tagline: A visibly brighter smile in one sitting
services.overview: In-clinic professional whitening using safe, enamel-friendly gels for even, noticeable results without the guesswork of store kits.
symptoms: Staining from tea, coffee, or tobacco
benefits: Visible results in a single visit
services.recovery: Mild sensitivity for a day or two is common and resolves on its own.

services.name: Dental Veneers
services.tagline: Thin, custom shells for a flawless front row
services.overview: Custom-fabricated porcelain veneers bonded to the front of teeth to correct chips, gaps, discolouration, or shape — a key part of our smile makeover work.
symptoms: Chipped, worn, or misshapen front teeth
Persistent staining that whitening can't fully fix
benefits: Corrects shape, shade, and minor gaps together
services.recovery: No real downtime — most patients return to normal eating within a day of final bonding.

services.name: Root Canal Treatment
services.tagline: Save the natural tooth, relieve the pain
services.overview: Root canal therapy for infected or badly decayed teeth, typically completed with a protective crown so the treated tooth holds up long-term.
symptoms: Lingering sensitivity to hot or cold
Swelling or tenderness near a tooth
procedure: Removal of infected pulp under local anaesthesia
Cleaning and sealing of the root canal
Crown placement to protect the tooth
benefits: Saves the natural tooth instead of extraction
Relieves pain from infection or decay
services.recovery: Mild soreness for 2–3 days is normal; a follow-up crown is typically placed within two weeks.

services.name: Dental Implants
services.tagline: A permanent replacement for missing teeth
services.overview: Titanium implants placed by Dr. Karthik to replace missing teeth, completed with a custom crown for a result that looks and functions naturally.
procedure: Custom crown fitted onto the implant
benefits: Functions and feels like a natural tooth
services.recovery: Initial healing takes 1–2 weeks; full osseointegration before crown placement typically takes 8–12 weeks.

services.tagline: Everyday care for every member of the family
services.overview: Routine check-ups, cleanings, fillings, and preventive care for children and adults — the everyday foundation of dental health.
symptoms: Due for a routine check-up or cleaning
procedure: Clinical exam and digital X-ray if needed
Fillings or minor treatment as required

services.recovery: No downtime for routine check-ups and cleanings; filling sensitivity settles within a few days.

blogPosts.title: Veneers vs. Whitening: What's Actually Right for Your Smile?
blogPosts.excerpt: Both brighten your smile, but they solve different problems. Here's how we help patients at Shine Dental Clinic decide between the two.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Priya Raghavan
content: Whitening lifts the shade of your existing teeth — it's fast, non-invasive, and ideal when your teeth are healthy and evenly shaped but just look duller than you'd like.
Veneers go further: thin porcelain shells bonded to the front of your teeth that can correct shape, minor gaps, and chips at the same time as shade, not just colour.

A simple way to think about it — if your only concern is colour, whitening usually solves it in a single sitting. If you also want to fix shape, alignment, or old staining that whitening can't touch, veneers are the better fit.
Cost and timeline differ too: whitening is a same-day, lower-cost option, while veneers involve impressions, lab fabrication, and a slightly longer process for a more permanent result.
We always start with a smile consultation so you're choosing based on what your teeth actually need, not just what sounds appealing.
